limits_note: the credit multiplier is the binding constraint: a defended page costs 11 credits and a Google SERP 25, so the plan's page count is a fifth to a twenty-fifth of its credit count

notes: A Google SERP costs 25 credits here, so the free grant is 40 searches on the engine that matters most. max_cost per scrape is the one feature worth copying.
